inbound.title: Breakfast with Santa: Pajama Party
inbound.location: Senior Center, 1303 Fremont St., Santa Clara

inbound.description: Corita Art Center director Nellie Scott, artist Terri Friedman, and guest curator Christine Koppes discuss Corita Kent's life, work, and influence on contemporary artists. Free and open to all, with an RSVP link provided.
